---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity Early-Environment GLMs: Multicollinearity and Effect Sizes"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Multicollinearity, effect sizes with 95% CI and minimum detectable effect sizes for the early-environment GLMs in preterm-born participants (Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 4). Models as in `GLM_analyses_essential.qmd` and `GLM_analyses_dHCP.qmd`. Spearman correlations and generalized VIF among the BLS environmental variables; partial r with 95% CI from the t statistic; sensitivity power analysis (80% power, alpha = 0.05 and 0.05/22).

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv`, `data/dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv`
- Outputs (`outputs/tables`):
  - `Revision_env_GLMs_effectsizes_CI_<date>.csv`: estimates, 95% CI and partial r (results/env_GLM_partial_r_CI.csv)
  - `Revision_env_GLMs_MDES_<date>.csv`: minimum detectable effect sizes (results/env_GLM_MDES.csv)
  - `Revision_env_model_VIF_bls_<date>.csv`: VIF, BLS (results/env_VIF_BLS.csv)
  - `Revision_env_vars_Spearman_bls<date>.csv`: Spearman correlations, BLS (results/env_Spearman_BLS.csv)

# 1 Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(here)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

### Helper functions

```{r}
# --- Partial r with 95% CI ---
add_partial_r <- function(res) {
  r <- effectsize::t_to_r(res$t_value, df_error = res$df_resid, ci = 0.95)
  res %>% mutate(partial_r = r$r, r_ci_lo = r$CI_low, r_ci_hi = r$CI_high)
}

# --- Minimum detectable effect size (sensitivity power analysis) ---
mdes <- function(df_resid, alpha, power = 0.80) {
  f2 <- pwr::pwr.f2.test(u = 1, v = df_resid, sig.level = alpha, power = power)$f2
  tibble(alpha = alpha, power = power, f2 = f2, partial_r = sqrt(f2 / (1 + f2)))
}

options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))
```

# 2 BLS cohort (adults)

## Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
    
    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

### Create subsets

```{r}
final_dat_CP <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cd_"), -any_of("id"))

cp_vars    <- grep("^cp_", names(final_dat_CP), value = TRUE)
env_vars   <- c("ses0y2_fac", "psi1", "betreu", "optws")
covars_BLS <- c("age_at_scan", "sex")

dat_PT_fac <- final_dat_CP %>%
  filter(group == "PT") %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(c(cp_vars, "psi1", "betreu", "optws")), ~ {
      if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
    }),
    ses0y2_fac = factor(ses0y2, levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                        labels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower")) # 1 = upper, 2 = middle, 3 = lower class
  )
```

## 2.1 Multicollinearity diagnostics

```{r}
dat_env_BLS <- dat_PT_fac %>% drop_na(all_of(c(env_vars, covars_BLS)))

# Spearman correlations among the four environmental variables
cor_env_BLS <- dat_env_BLS %>%
  transmute(SES = as.numeric(ses0y2_fac), PSI = psi1, PIRI = betreu,
            `Pregnancy optimality` = optws) %>%
  cor(method = "spearman")

# Generalized VIF of the full model
fml_vif <- as.formula(paste(cp_vars[1], "~", paste(c(env_vars, covars_BLS), collapse = " + ")))
fit_vif <- lm(fml_vif, data = dat_env_BLS)

vif_BLS <- car::vif(fit_vif) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  rename(df = Df, GVIF_adj = `GVIF^(1/(2*Df))`) %>%
  mutate(VIF_equivalent = GVIF_adj^2)
```

## 2.2 Full model with 95% CI and partial r

```{r}
results_env_BLS <- map_dfr(cp_vars, function(dv) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(c(env_vars, covars_BLS), collapse = " + ")))
  df  <- dat_PT_fac[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  
  tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(grepl("^ses0y2_fac", term) | term %in% env_vars) %>%
    mutate(conf.low  = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
           conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
           dv = dv, n = nrow(df), df_resid = df.residual(fit))
}) %>%
  rename(t_value = statistic) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  add_partial_r()
```

## 2.3 Sensitivity power analysis - minimum detectable effect (mdes)

```{r}
df_resid_BLS <- unique(results_env_BLS$df_resid)
stopifnot(length(df_resid_BLS) == 1)

mdes_BLS <- map_dfr(c(0.05, 0.05 / 22), ~ mdes(df_resid_BLS, .x)) %>%
  mutate(cohort = "BLS (preterm adults)", n = unique(results_env_BLS$n), df_resid = df_resid_BLS)
```

# 3 dHCP cohort (neonates)

## Load data

```{r}
dat_dHCP <- read_delim(
  here("data", "dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv"),
  delim = ",",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = "."),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject_ID = col_character(),
    Session_ID = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

cp_vars_dHCP <- grep("^l_|^r_", names(dat_dHCP), value = TRUE)
covars_dHCP  <- c("scan_age", "sex")

dat_dHCP_PT_num <- dat_dHCP %>%
  mutate(group = factor(case_when(
    group == "term" ~ "FT",
    group == "pre"  ~ "PT",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ), levels = c("FT", "PT"))) %>%
  filter(group == "PT") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(cp_vars_dHCP, "ses_score")), as.numeric))
```

## 3.1 SES model with 95% CIs and partial r

```{r}
results_SES_dHCP <- map_dfr(cp_vars_dHCP, function(dv) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(c("ses_score", covars_dHCP), collapse = " + ")))
  df  <- dat_dHCP_PT_num[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)
  
  tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "ses_score") %>%
    mutate(conf.low  = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
           conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
           dv = dv, n = nrow(df), df_resid = df.residual(fit))
}) %>%
  rename(t_value = statistic) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  add_partial_r()
```

## 3.2 Sensitivity power analysis

```{r}
df_resid_dHCP <- unique(results_SES_dHCP$df_resid)
stopifnot(length(df_resid_dHCP) == 1)

mdes_dHCP <- map_dfr(c(0.05, 0.05 / 22), ~ mdes(df_resid_dHCP, .x)) %>%
  mutate(cohort = "dHCP (preterm neonates)", n = unique(results_SES_dHCP$n), df_resid = df_resid_dHCP)
```

# 4 Summary

## Detectable effect sizes

```{r}
mdes_all <- bind_rows(mdes_dHCP, mdes_BLS) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, n, df_resid, alpha, power, f2, partial_r)
```

## Observed effect sizes and CIs

```{r}
results_env_all <- bind_rows(
  `dHCP (preterm neonates)` = results_SES_dHCP %>% mutate(roi = unname(roi_labels_dHCP[dv])),
  `BLS (preterm adults)`    = results_env_BLS  %>% mutate(roi = unname(roi_labels[dv])),
  .id = "cohort"
) %>%
  mutate(term_label = unname(term_labels[term]))
```

## Table

```{r}
table_env_all <- results_env_all %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Cohort = cohort, ROI = roi, Term = term_label,
    Estimate = estimate, `95% CI lo` = conf.low, `95% CI hi` = conf.high,
    t = t_value, df = df_resid, p = p.value, `p (FDR)` = p_fdr,
    `partial r` = partial_r, `r 95% CI lo` = r_ci_lo, `r 95% CI hi` = r_ci_hi, N = n
  )
```

## Save outputs

```{r}
write_csv2(table_env_all, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_env_GLMs_effectsizes_CI_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv")))
write_csv2(vif_BLS,       file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_env_model_VIF_bls_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv")))
write_csv2(as_tibble(cor_env_BLS, rownames = "variable"),
           file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_env_vars_Spearman_bls", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv")))
write_csv2(mdes_all,      file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_env_GLMs_MDES_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv")))
```
